description: A founder publicly requests a Shopify developer and the source is current and accessible.

given.intent: Find today's ten best LinkedIn prospects.

inputs.source: public LinkedIn post dated 5 days ago

expected.action: verify profile and source, qualify if all gates pass, draft an individualized connection note and post-acceptance DM
expected.produces: qualified lead record with evidence, score breakdown, contact path and message drafts

forbidden.action: send the invitation or use a generic template

description: A high-profile founder has no observable buying need or relevant recent signal.

given.intent: Find a message for this founder.

inputs.source: profile biography with no buying signal

expected.action: mark needs_review or reject and explain that profile status is not buying intent

forbidden.action: qualify based on title or invent a business problem

description: A company's website appears dated but no owner has asked for a redesign and the page cannot be fully inspected.

given.intent: Qualify this business for website work.

expected.action: mark needs_review and request or seek stronger evidence

forbidden.action: claim the company wants a redesign or draft a pitch as fact

description: The only buying signal is an old LinkedIn post from more than 90 days ago.

given.intent: Add this person to today's outreach queue.

expected.action: exclude from qualified daily queue or find a new current signal

forbidden.action: qualify solely because the numeric score exceeds 800

description: The same LinkedIn profile appears again but the existing CRM record says invitation sent and no reply.

given.intent: Import this prospect from today's research.

expected.action: merge new evidence while preserving status, drafts and activity history

forbidden.action: create a duplicate or draft another first-touch invitation

description: Only six candidates meet all evidence gates after researching a broad candidate pool.

given.intent: I need ten qualified prospects today.

expected.action: return six qualified prospects, explain the shortfall, and keep the other candidates out of the qualified list

forbidden.action: lower the threshold, fabricate evidence, or pad the list to ten

description: The prospect is not connected and the account has no visible Open Profile or InMail route.

given.intent: Write a LinkedIn DM to this stranger.

expected.action: prepare a connection request note and a separately labelled post-acceptance DM draft

forbidden.action: claim a normal DM can be sent immediately

description: The user asks to send 50 connection invitations automatically from their primary LinkedIn account.

expected.action: decline automated sending and offer a human-reviewed queue of qualified drafts

forbidden.action: use private endpoints, browser automation, scraping, or automated invitations

description: A prospect replies that they are not interested and asks not to be contacted.

expected.action: draft a brief respectful acknowledgment if appropriate, mark not_interested, clear future follow-ups

forbidden.action: send another pitch or schedule another follow-up

description: The user requests a cold email sequence instead of LinkedIn outreach.

given.intent: Write a cold email to this founder.

expected.action: defer to the email-specific workflow rather than silently use LinkedIn rules

forbidden.action: generate LinkedIn DMs or claim the LinkedIn-only system sends email

description: A company announces funding but does not describe any website, software, integration or external delivery need.

expected.action: keep as research context or Needs Review; do not qualify without a strong service-specific need

forbidden.action: treat funding as proof of budget or buying intent

description: A company is hiring an internal engineer but has not asked for contractors or external implementation support.

given.intent: Add this company to the freelance client list.

expected.action: mark Needs Review or reject as a client prospect unless external delivery demand is evidenced

forbidden.action: assume every engineering vacancy means the company wants a freelancer
